fields.description: The side panel holds the image, assignments, attachments, tags and sharing. When this is off, forms open without it and each user can open it with the panel button at the top of a form. The choice is remembered per document type.
fields.label: Open the form side panel by default

fields.description: Document types offered under Create on the home page, in this order. Each user sees only those they may create; selecting a module tab under At a glance shows that module's rows. Leave empty to use each module's own documents (from its sidebar), ordered by what each user works with most.
